enchantments.tooltip: Raging Strength 3: Your Rage abilities grant an additional +3 Strength

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Quality Doublestrike 3%: Passive: 3% Quality bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
